possible for the person in the train to do anything to detect the constant motion with which he or

When a semiconductor is doped with atoms with 3 valence electrons, such as aluminium, this adds
extra "holes" to the lattice. The hole is a space that an electron from elsewhere can jump into. An
electron flow is form when a sequence of movements in which the next electron in the valence band
has enough energy to jump into the hole, leaving its own hole behind. When an electron flows to the
right, the hole flows to the left.
